tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search everything the index knows (APIs, MCP servers, A2A agents and the operations, tools and skills they expose) for what an agent needs to do. Use this first when you do not know which kind of thing you need. Supports field filters such as api:payment or op:refund method:POST.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Search REST and GraphQL APIs only. Use when you need an HTTP API to call. Supports field filters such as op:refund method:POST or auth:oauth.

tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search remote MCP servers only. Use when you need ready-made tools an agent can call over MCP. Supports filters such as tool:search or auth:none.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search A2A agents only. Use when you need another agent to delegate a task to. Supports filters such as skill:booking.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get one API, MCP server or agent by slug: description, endpoint, auth, protocols, provenance and verification level (declared, observed or protocol_verified). Use after a search to inspect a result before using it.

tools.name: browse_organizations
tools.description: Browse indexed organizations (sites) and what each offers to agents. Use to explore by popularity or to list every site that offers an API, MCP server or agent.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the tags (categories such as payments, maps-location, ai-llm) with how many organizations and entities carry each. Use to explore what the index covers, then pass a slug as the tag argument of browse_organizations or as tag:<slug> in a search query. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Everything indexed for one organization: its APIs, MCP servers and agents, the discovery files found on its site (llms.txt, OpenAPI, agent card...) and its description. Use to see the whole picture of a site.

tools.name: get_organization_items
tools.description: List an organization's APIs, MCP servers or agents, or fetch one of them. Use after get_organization when you want the details of one item.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: List the operations, tools and skills of one API, MCP server or agent (paged). Use to find the exact call to make. Filter by group, kind, HTTP method or text; can show older versions or removed items.

tools.name: get_entity_versions
tools.description: Version history of an API, MCP server or agent, or the list of changes in one version. Use to see what was added, changed or removed over time.

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Prefix suggestions for organization and entity names, for autocomplete. Returns at most a few matches per type.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question and get ranked matches with schema.org hints (NLWeb-style). Use when you want a few best answers rather than a filtered list.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The guide for making a website agent-ready, as markdown: every signal mocop looks for and how to enable it. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: my_domains
tools.description: The signed-in user's claimed domains with verification instructions and latest readiness score. Requires sign-in. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: domain_dns_guide
tools.description: Where a claimed domain's DNS is hosted and the exact TXT record to publish to verify it. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Check the verification record for a claimed domain; a verified domain is queued for indexing. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Claim a domain you own; returns the DNS TXT record or file to publish for verification. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description: The domains the signed-in user follows. Requires sign-in. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: favorite_domain
tools.description: Follow a domain so it appears in the user's favorites. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: unfavorite_domain
tools.description: Stop following a domain. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Score how agent-ready a website is (0-10) with per-area checks, recommendations and the discovered endpoints. Works for any public site, signed in or not. Results are cached for an hour.

tools.name: get_domain_discovery
tools.description: List everything indexed for a domain: its organization, APIs, MCP servers, agents and discovery files. Returns domain_not_indexed if we have nothing for it.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_entity" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get one API, MCP server or agent by slug: description, endpoint, auth, protocols, provenance and verification level (declared, observed or protocol_verified). U…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_capabilities, search_apis · Private data: get_organization, domain_dns_guide, verify_domain, add_domain, get_domain_discovery · Public sink: search_capabilities, search_apis, domain_dns_guide, add_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_capabilities, search_apis · Private data: get_organization, domain_dns_guide, verify_domain, add_domain, get_domain_discovery · Public sink: search_capabilities, search_apis, domain_dns_guide, add_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
